summary: Vivos Therapeutics filed an 8-K/A correcting the report date of its Original 8-K to September 2, 2026 for debt-for-equity exchanges with Streeterville Capital under the June 2025 Secured Promissory Note. Twelve exchange agreements partitioned $2,861,270 of principal into separate secured notes, following prior swaps: 785,822 shares for $975,000 of redemptions (December 2025–May 2026) and $3,250,000 of principal exchanged on August 4, 2026 for 2,500 Series B preferred and 1,812,031 common shares. The structural overhang and ongoing conversion-driven dilution are the key risk-arb considerations.
